references.text: Describes how kings and leaders gather to stand against the Lord and His Anointed, parallel to how the chief priests and elders gather against Jesus.
The chief priests and Pharisees seek a way to arrest Jesus, which mirrors their actions in Matt 26:3.
The chief priests and scribes seek a way to kill Jesus, parallel to the planning to capture Jesus in Matt 26:3.
The chief priests, temple guards, and elders confront Jesus in Gethsemane, following from their conspiracy in Matt 26:3.
